crossRefs.note: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant…
David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make…
David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to…
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

translations.web: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”
translations.bsb: Furthermore, whom should I serve if not his son? As I served in your father’s presence, so also I will serve in yours.”
translations.kjv: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
translations.asv: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
